# Percy Jackson: concept-art requests

<!-- Generated by design/source/build_requests.py; edit the data there. -->

Concept art for a game of *The Lightning Thief*, in the chosen direction:
**cartoon heroes in an ornamental world**. The heroes are clean, bright cartoon
characters; the world, maps and interface are flat decorative illustration in
the manner of Greek vases, with black-and-gold frames. See
[the style reference](../reference/README.md), families 5, 6 and 10.

These images are for planning: they set the look of the cast and places
before any game is built. They are not yet game assets.

## How to generate

1. Generate **`key-art` first**. It fixes the look. Attach it as a reference to
   every later request, together with the sheets named in each **References**
   line.
2. Then the character sheets, then the places and situations, then the
   interface.
3. Save each image as `<id>.png` (for example `char-percy.png`) and drop it in
   [`../intake/`](../intake/README.md). On integration it moves to
   `design/concept/` and this document is rebuilt.

Every prompt includes the shared style and palette, so each can be pasted as it
is. Prompts describe the look rather than naming any artist, and the characters
are original designs drawn from the books, not likenesses of actors.

## Shared style

> Cartoon heroes in an ornamental world: the characters are drawn in a clean, bright cartoon style (ink outlines, flat cel-shaded colour, expressive faces) and stand in front of a world painted as flat decorative illustration: layered patterned shapes, waves, clouds and smoke drawn as curling ornamental ribbons, Greek-key and wave-scroll borders, black-figure and red-figure vase motifs, fine gold-leaf linework on deep teal, navy and black grounds, a subtle paper grain. Modern places (New York, highways, Las Vegas) get the same ornamental treatment, so that skyscrapers and neon look as if painted on an ancient vase. Exciting rather than frightening: monsters are bold and dramatic, never gory. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3.

Character sheets use:

> Clean, bright cartoon illustration for a 2D adventure game for players aged 8 to 14: confident ink outlines of varying weight, flat cel-shaded colour with one shadow tone and a small highlight, expressive faces with large readable eyes but natural proportions (the twelve-year-olds about six heads tall), lively poses and strong silhouettes that read at small size. Original character designs, not likenesses of any actor. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3.

### Style key

#### `key-art` — Key art: the three heroes set out

- **File:** `key-art.png`, 2560 × 1440 px
- **References:** none (generate first)
- **Use:** Fixes the look. Generate it first and attach it to every later request.
- **Status:** requested

> Key art for a game of Rick Riordan's The Lightning Thief. The three heroes stand on Half-Blood Hill at golden hour beside a tall, lone pine tree, looking out toward a distant ornamental New York skyline and a stormy sky crackling with stylised lightning bolts. Percy Jackson, twelve, son of Poseidon: slim, messy jet-black hair, sea-green eyes, a lopsided troublemaker grin; orange Camp Half-Blood T-shirt (a small black pegasus emblem), faded jeans, worn sneakers; Riptide, a leaf-shaped celestial-bronze sword that turns into a ballpoint pen when capped; Annabeth Chase, twelve, daughter of Athena: athletic, tanned, curly honey-blonde hair in a high ponytail, sharp storm-grey eyes, a confident, calculating look; orange Camp Half-Blood T-shirt, shorts, a clay-bead camp necklace, a bronze dagger at her belt and a navy New York Yankees-style baseball cap (no logo) that makes her invisible; Grover Underwood, a satyr who looks about twelve: lanky, curly brown hair hiding two small horns, a wispy goatee, kind nervous eyes; in disguise a cap, a T-shirt, baggy jeans over furry goat legs and oversized fake sneakers; carries reed pipes and nibbles a tin can. Percy holds Riptide drawn, Annabeth points the way, Grover clutches his pipes. The scene sits inside a black-and-gold ornamental frame of Greek-key borders with small emblems in the corners (a trident, an owl, a lightning bolt, a pan pipe) and an empty cartouche at the top for the title. Cartoon heroes in an ornamental world: the characters are drawn in a clean, bright cartoon style (ink outlines, flat cel-shaded colour, expressive faces) and stand in front of a world painted as flat decorative illustration: layered patterned shapes, waves, clouds and smoke drawn as curling ornamental ribbons, Greek-key and wave-scroll borders, black-figure and red-figure vase motifs, fine gold-leaf linework on deep teal, navy and black grounds, a subtle paper grain. Modern places (New York, highways, Las Vegas) get the same ornamental treatment, so that skyscrapers and neon look as if painted on an ancient vase. Exciting rather than frightening: monsters are bold and dramatic, never gory. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
